verdict.rationale: The formation page says the firm helps founders make "tax-efficient choices around how to structure their business entities and ownership," which touches day-zero ownership only in general terms. The executive compensation page covers restricted stock and vesting schedules, but for employee incentive equity rather than founder equity. Missing for 10: any material on 83(b) elections or a local equivalent, guidance on co-founder equity splits, founder-specific vesting content, public founder-facing explainers (the Catalyze Knowledge Hub is client-only and its content is unevidenced), and independent corroboration.
